name: Calendar
description: Syncs an ICS feed into machine-owned documents and renders a month view from fm.date.
author: Life Manager base distribution

feed_url.label: ICS feed URL
feed_url.description: The calendar's published .ics address. Its host must be added to this plugin's approved http hosts at approval time — see backend/HOST-ABI.md.

feed_id.label: Feed label
feed_id.description: Short name recorded in each event's %%% calendar section, so two feeds can share one workspace.

auth_header.label: Authorization header
auth_header.description: Optional. Sent verbatim as `Authorization` when fetching the feed.
